configurations.//: THE DEFAULT. A real build without the image: same Postgres, same models, same WASM renderer, same bundled fonts, and `/api/render` returns a byte-identical PDF to the container's. 5 seconds end to end on this Mac — 3s to build, 2s to boot.
configurations.//2: What it does NOT have is LibreOffice and Tesseract, which live in the image and deliberately not on a laptop (ADR-012). So `.doc` ingestion and OCR of a scan fail here and only here. Those two paths, and the last check before a release, belong to the entry below.
configurations.//3: Needs db and llm, which are separate services and cheap: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d db llm
configurations.name: hunterready-host

configurations.//: The one that ships. Attaches to the real stack — the app image plus Postgres plus the model — started with `pnpm app` (Compose builds `hunterready-app:latest`; NOT `pnpm docker:run`, which starts the app alone with no database and no model, so persistence reports itself off and every generated text silently falls back to regular expressions).
configurations.//2: Reach for it for exactly three things: `.doc` ingestion, OCR of a scan, and confirming the shipping image itself is sound before a release. Otherwise it costs 2 minutes warm and 10+ when the apt layer falls out of cache, for nothing the entry above does not already give you.
configurations.//3: 3100 because Hermes' WhatsApp bridge holds 127.0.0.1:3000 while Docker publishes on *:3000, and a URL that resolves to one of two servers depending on v4/v6 order is not something to debug twice.
configurations.//4: There used to be a third entry here, `hunterready-ui` on 3007: Vite with HMR, proxying /api to this container. It was removed on 2026-08-18 once `pnpm host` was measured at 5 seconds. It saved two of those and required this container to be running to answer a single API call, which is the cost it existed to avoid. What was lost is HMR preserving app state across an edit; if that turns out to matter, bring it back pointing at 3011, not here.
configurations.name: hunterready
